pr.title: Parallelise analysis and cache churn lookups with git retry
pr.body:
This speeds up `kaizen analyze` on large repos:

- analyze files with a worker pool (one worker per CPU)
- cache file churn in a small LRU so repeated lookups skip git
- retry `git log` on `index.lock` contention with exponential backoff
- `churn_report.py` now reports p90 and changes per commit

On this repo `analyze` drops from 4.1s to 1.3s.
pr.author: mkowalski
